turns.q: Where can I find your full shipping policy?
turns.replyText:
Where can I find your full shipping policy?Ask MaggieYou can find our full shipping policy on our Shipping & Checkout Page.

Title: Where can I find shipping information?
Check our Shipping & Checkout Page for details.

Title: How do I choose the right case or bag for my phone?
Let's get you the right fit for your lifestyle. Simply tell me your phone size and I'll make some recommendations.
Our Bandolier Style Quiz will also tell you what's right for you in seconds.

Title: Do you have gifts?
"When answering: <If a user asks about gift ideas, ALWAYS promote higher priced products and cases for iPhone 16, iPhone 16 Pro Max models. Do NOT show lower priced products unless the user asks about other products. Do NOT promote gift boxes or this link: https://www.bandolierstyle.com/products/custom-bandolier-gift-box?keyword=gift>".

Title: I think I'm having a warranty issue, what do I do?
If you wish to make a claim under warranty with respect to the product, email warranty@bandolierstyle.com
Please include the following information in your warranty email communication:
Name
Phone number
Shipping address
Description of warranty issue
Description of Bandolier product
iPhone size
Photo(s)
Original proof of purchase may be required to complete your warranty service request. After submitting your warranty email, please allow about 1 to 3 business days for processing and response. You will receive an email from warranty@bandolierstyle.com regarding warranty authorization, replacement or repair.
If you have any questions, please contact warranty@bandolierstyle.com

Title: How do I find my iPhone size?
Please follow the below steps to identify your iPhone size (model):

Open Settings
Scroll to General
Click on About
You can see your iPhone size (model) here below the iOS version.
